Menu values and tool scores are fitted predictions. Use the observed evidence, state a testable short hypothesis, and specify edits that match displayed candidate identities on the pinned GFP reference. All eligible candidates are from a fixed menu. Do not estimate or cite measurements for candidates. Keep all text fields concise and evidence-specific.

decision.analyst: Recent single substitutions are generally bright; favor untested single-site menu candidates, with O8 supporting E142A tolerance.
decision.hypothesis: Among these menu singles, substitutions at non-chromophore sites are more likely to preserve high brightness than multi-mutation designs.
decision.critic: All six evaluated singles received the same model estimate, so the estimates do not distinguish their priorities. They are predictions, not measured fluorescence; the observed single-mutant examples vary in brightness and do not establish that these candidates will be bright.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize five of the evaluated single substitutions: C01, C14, C25, C28, and C36. Each has a returned estimate of 3.7138, so this ordering is a tie-break rather than a model-supported ranking. O6–O10 show that several observed single substitutions had high measured fluorescence, but they do not directly validate these candidates.
